label: Figure 5.9: Average and marginal product curves
alt: Marginal product (MP) and average product (AP) curves for labour: MP peaks at 5 workers, AP peaks at 7.5 workers, and MP cuts AP from above at AP's maximum.
caption: Marginal product (MP) rises to a peak of 15 bicycles at 5 workers and then falls as diminishing returns set in. Average product (AP) peaks later, at 7.5 workers, where MP crosses it; MP falls below AP and drags it down.
